messages.content: Answer with a list of items, instead of bullet points use -. No two consecutive words can share the same first letter. write a description of the 20th century in an over-dramatic, biblical style

message.content:
- In the era of steel, mankind wept for war
- From the dust of trenches, nations fell as lambs
- And the skies burned with flame over all
- The great powers drew blood upon the earth
- A thousand souls perished in the furnace of grief
- Yet from the ashes, new powers arose to rule
- The century was marked by two great cataclysms
- First of fire, then of steel, each more terrible
- The world trembled before the might of man
- And the moon saw the footsteps of humankind
- No rest came for those who lived in that age
